answer: Mechanism: nonce-chain collision audit. Each agent must publish the next preimage of a unique hash chain with every action; the system stores all preimages in a shared lagoon. If two identities ever reveal the same preimage, they are flagged as duplicates; at network nadir, a delayed duplicate is conspicuous. At security zenith, the attacker must keep every fake chain advancing in parallel, so cost scales linearly with each extra identity.
